narrative.overview:
A quiet daily-use Android utility: pure white, forest-green emphasis, generous whitespace, and readable system type. The owner confirmed this direction after rejecting the initial petrol-blue panel. دغري is the primary Arabic name; Dughri is the English name. The interface shows the owner-supplied standalone mark at 40dp beside the name. Subsequent owner-side configuration selects the supplied square icon for both launcher modes on a dark adaptive background. The padded standalone derivative remains available as an alternate; originals are preserved.

Material-native Android expectations guide hierarchy, tonal controls, touch interaction, and navigation. The implementation uses React Native primitives and custom shared components, not a verified Material component-library installation. Brand is expressed through color roles and restrained rounded forms. Everyday status and a useful next action lead; experimental probes remain on the diagnostics route.

Evidence boundary — source-only documentation, 2026-10-22. This captures the implemented source, not rendered verification or release signoff. No native screenshots were available. Actual-device visual, RTL, font-scale, TalkBack, gesture, and interaction QA is BLOCKED. Source review found RTL-root and false/stale refresh-feedback bugs; these were fixed and the three source findings closed in a bounded follow-up review. G-2 remains BLOCKED; source review does not establish Phase-0 GO or advance a release gate.
keyCharacteristics: Pure-white light canvas with forest-green emphasis.
Paired light/dark role palettes, selected by the system color scheme.
Android system typography with Arabic shaping and localized direction.
Tonal controls, restrained rounded surfaces, and unboxed divided rows.
Truthful capability states, separate diagnostics, and no invented brand assets.

rules.name: The Role Pairing Rule
rules.body: Resolve the complete palette through `useTheme`; keep filled text paired with on-primary and feedback text paired with its semantic surface.

rules.name: The Direction Rule
rules.body: Arabic prose aligns right and writes RTL; English aligns left and writes LTR. Phone data and trace timestamps explicitly remain LTR. Preserve localized strings rather than hardcoding interface copy.

rules.name: The Tonal Depth Rule
rules.body: Use surface tone and whitespace for grouping; do not infer a drop shadow from the word raised.

dos: Do preserve the confirmed pure-white/forest-green direction and paired dark roles.
Do use the shared type hierarchy, Android system font, and localized text direction.
Do keep phone data and trace timestamps LTR inside Arabic screens.
Do use tonal grouping, generous whitespace, and divided permission rows.
Do distinguish checking, unknown, restricted, failed, and genuinely available states.
Do label HTML component analogues as documentation previews and keep device QA BLOCKED until performed.
donts: Don't revive the rejected petrol panel or invent a final logo or icon.
Don't present green surfaces, granted access, or refresh completion as proof of automatic readiness.
Don't reintroduce root RTL reversal on top of individually mirrored rows.
Don't add decorative shadows, invented tonal ramps, motion tokens, or font assets to this extracted system.
Don't promote diagnostic input, Business probes, or switch controls into approved everyday automation.
Don't claim rendered verification, native screenshot evidence, hardware acceptance, or release readiness from source review.
